about: How the Stage cuts a part into levels; CHARTING.md explains every knob. Each part has a ladder of tiers, easiest first. Easy, Medium and Hard each name a tier, and Adaptive walks the ladder one step at a time. A tier: notes = chord notes kept, in `keep` order (null = all); hits = the heaviest weight played as written (1 the hits a part stands on, 2 the groove, 3 pushes and ornaments); gap = seconds at least between two onsets; space = seconds at most without an onset (a longer silence borrows a lighter hit; null = never); bonus = points per hit times this.
